name: Sharon
title: Well-being Therapist
bio:
I am a compassionate Well-Being Therapist specialising in Hypnotherapy, Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP), EMDR, and Drawing & Talking Therapy. My mission is to help individuals overcome emotional barriers, process difficult experiences, and build lasting resilience in a safe, supportive environment.

With a background in early years education and teaching, I have extensive experience supporting children and young people, including those with disabilities and neurodiversity. I work with clients facing trauma, anxiety, depression, phobias and behavioural challenges.

My client-centred approach is tailored to each individual, creating a warm, non-judgmental space where people of all ages feel understood, empowered, and confident to heal and thrive.
